officialSyllabusPrimaryLevelIdentityChec.qualification: Conservative unique-ID mapping checks exact official ID, spelling or an independently verified traditional form, and tone-marked Pinyin against CTI HSK 3.0 2025-11. It excludes 15 IDs across 8 same-spelling/reading cases that span multiple CTI levels, plus 42 published entries whose only CTI level is 7-9. Internal HSK fields are not used to assign official levels. This does not claim full semantic or teaching-material coverage.
